STATSIG_CLIENT_API_KEY.description: Statsig says to use client keys where the key itself cannot be secret, such as a mobile or web app. The names here are convention: Statsig's SDKs take the key as an argument.

STATSIG_SERVER_SECRET_KEY.description: Statsig says to keep server secret keys private, and that an exposed one is disabled and recreated rather than rotated.

STATSIG_CONSOLE_API_KEY.description: Statsig calls these the most powerful keys in a project: they read the whole configuration and can create, update and delete anything in it.
